rationale: final-round re-raise: sibling_files_read is another set-semantics array whose permutation shifts the digest. Same class as seeds/verdicts/findings (all now sorted). Deferred to a future review-harness hardening pass — not fund-loss; the replay guard already blocks substantively-identical rounds, and this enables only re-recording a permuted-but-identical round as fresh (seeded_count/coverage unaffected). A0 closed on convergence (3 rounds, 0 program findings)

title: The committed scorecard drops feasible reproducer coordinates

suggested_fix: Persist the complete untrusted reproducer object under a claimed_reproducer field in each committed scorecard row, or track the canonical artefact itself. Add a fresh-clone retention test and bind reused WRDF ids to an explicit stable-identity fingerprint or human ruling.
rationale: final-round re-raise: the scorecard now carries title/file/line/suggested_fix/infeasible_reason but not a feasible reproducer's path+name. Deferred to the same harness pass — the raw artefact is session-local by policy and the committed line already conveys the finding's substance. Not fund-loss

title: A client-attested cluster_tag cannot enforce the dev-build mainnet prohibition
reproducer_infeasible_reason: No extension implementation or fixed SHA exists in this range. A future regression must submit a dev-origin create_account carrying a non-mainnet tag to the mainnet-configured program and require program-level rejection.
suggested_fix: Pin the permitted production rp_id_hash/origin in deployment-specific on-chain configuration and reject other origins during mainnet account creation, or narrow WRD-ORG-01 to an honest-client accidental-use guard. Test the program-level boundary with a dev origin and deliberately non-mainnet cluster_tag.
rationale: adopted: WRD-ORG-01 statement + C1a task now rest the guarantee on origin binding (rp_id_hash pinned in deploy config), with the cluster_tag refusal explicitly labeled an honest-client guard — cluster_tag is caller-attested (transcript.rs:99-106)

title: Deploy attestation does not bind ProgramData authority to the audited Squads vault
reproducer_infeasible_reason: This is a future deployment/configuration attestation with no implementation or fixed SHA in the reviewed range; the counterexample follows from the two independently supplied identities.
suggested_fix: Add an upgrade-governance invariant. Pin the Squads program id and vault index, owner/discriminator-check and decode the multisig, derive its canonical vault PDA, and require ProgramData.upgrade_authority_address to equal that PDA. Add negative fixtures for an unrelated valid multisig, wrong vault index, wrong member count, spoofed owner/discriminator, and direct signer authority.
rationale: adopted (critical): Task 11R now derives the canonical Squads vault PDA from the decoded multisig and requires ProgramData.upgrade_authority == it, never accepting authority+multisig as independent facts; new WRD-DEP-01 + a single-key-authority-with-unrelated-multisig negative fixture

title: Task 11R can mark the deploy gate done while the Registry selector check remains a stub
reproducer_infeasible_reason: Task 11R and its RPC fixture suite do not yet exist, so there is no fixed SHA for the required base-red/fixed-green execution.
suggested_fix: Add a deploy-selector invariant and implement live Registry decoding plus deterministic selector re-derivation/diffing in Task 11R. Add fixtures for missing, extra, wrong, and duplicate selectors and role-validator mismatches; prohibit Task 11 DONE until every numbered DEPLOY-GATE check is executable and green.
rationale: adopted: Task 11R scopes out DEPLOY-GATE check 3 (adapter-selector/Registry diff, WRD-DEP-02 — needs Task 3 registry + Task 5 selectors); Task 11 PARTIAL→DONE now requires BOTH 11R and WRD-DEP-02

title: The 3% quote check is not bound to one economic quantity
reproducer_infeasible_reason: The quote providers, approval flow, and fixed implementation do not exist in this range; this is a dimensional and request-binding defect in the newly added contract.
suggested_fix: Define a canonical QuoteIntent bound to approval id and exact message digest, account, cluster, mint pubkeys and decimals, swap mode, base-unit amount, slippage/fee convention, and route constraints. Bind both quotes to it; define 300-bps divergence with an explicit denominator, checked cross-multiplication, overflow bounds, and rounding direction; recreate the approval whenever a re-quote changes a bound field.
rationale: adopted: C4b defines a canonical QuoteIntent (approval id+digest, account, cluster, mints+decimals, mode, base-unit amount, convention), binds both quotes to it, and specifies the divergence denominator/rounding at 300 bps; WRD-QTE-01 updated

title: The wallet spec permits vanity onboarding before mandatory signature and decode prerequisites
reproducer_infeasible_reason: These client phases are plans only; no V4 integration or fixed SHA exists from which to construct the required base-red/fixed-green executable test.
suggested_fix: Make the spec and WRD-VAN-03 ledger note require C1a+C2a+C3+C4, and add a machine-checked dependency assertion so V4 cannot become complete while any prerequisite remains incomplete.
rationale: adopted: spec §6.1 and the WRD-VAN-03 note now require C1a+C2a+C3+C4 (matching the vanity plan), closing the spec-vs-plan inconsistency I introduced

title: The origin fix still tests post-creation mismatch instead of mainnet creation refusal
reproducer_infeasible_reason: Neither an extension nor a deployment-origin configuration exists, and no fixed SHA exists for a base-red/fixed-green executable pair. The future regression must submit a valid dev-origin create_account directly to a mainnet-configured program and require rejection.
suggested_fix: Name and implement an immutable or governed on-chain/deployment value for the permitted production rp_id_hash and require create_account to compare against it on mainnet. Make C1a acceptance include a direct dev-origin create transaction with an arbitrary attacker-chosen cluster_tag that fails at the program boundary; retain the A-versus-B test as a separate post-creation binding test.
rationale: adopted: C1a now names a program-enforced permitted production rp_id_hash (const or governed config) and a create_account mainnet-refusal, with a creation-REFUSAL red test (not a post-creation mismatch that passes even if creation accepts all origins)

title: Task 11R's fixture lane still does not prove the audited Squads identity
reproducer_infeasible_reason: Task 11R, its recorded-RPC fixtures, and a fixed SHA do not exist yet, so the required base-red/fixed-green execution cannot be run. Future negatives must independently mutate account owner/discriminator, vault index, and member count while keeping every other field valid.
suggested_fix: Make exact member_count == 5, Squads program owner and account discriminator, pinned vault index, and canonical PDA seed derivation explicit assertions. Add one valid-looking negative fixture for each omitted predicate, plus a fixture binding the Warden Program account to the owner-checked ProgramData account; promote WRD-DEP-01 only when all fail through the production parsing path.
rationale: adopted (critical): Task 11R fixtures now force explicit owner/discriminator/member_count==5/vault-index/canonical-PDA assertions, each with a valid-looking negative fixture a lazy checker would fail

title: ExactOut quotes always agree under the output-only divergence rule
reproducer_infeasible_reason: No quote implementation or fixed SHA exists. A future fixture must hold ExactOut output constant, vary required input beyond 300 bps, and be red before the mode-specific fix and green after it.
suggested_fix: Define the compared adverse quantity by mode: net output after all fees for ExactIn and total required input after all fees for ExactOut. Pin the denominator, checked integer cross-multiplication, overflow bounds, and conservative rounding direction, and add below/at/above-300-bps fixtures for both modes, including constant-output/divergent-input ExactOut quotes.
rationale: adopted: the divergence-checked adverse quantity is mode-dependent — net output after fees for ExactIn, total required input after fees for ExactOut — with a required ExactOut fixture; output-only would render agreement for an adverse ExactOut input quote

title: Extension-id equality does not distinguish UI pages from content scripts
reproducer_infeasible_reason: apps/extension does not exist and no fixed SHA is available. The future browser regression must open the privileged port from an actual content script whose sender.id equals chrome.runtime.id and show rejection only after the sender-origin rule is fixed.
suggested_fix: Authorize each privileged UI surface only when sender.id equals chrome.runtime.id and browser-owned sender.url/origin has the exact chrome-extension://<id> origin and an allowed extension page path. Treat http(s), opaque, missing, and content-script page/frame origins as provider context regardless of port name. Test with a real content script carrying the same extension id, including top-frame and iframe cases.
rationale: adopted: WRD-EXT-02 and C1 now require sender.id==runtime.id AND the exact chrome-extension origin at an allowed page path; an extension content script shares sender.id and can runtime.connect (Chrome docs)

title: Rolled-back debits can emit indistinguishable success events
reproducer_infeasible_reason: Task 5 execute/swap events and the notifier do not exist, and there is no fixed SHA. A future regression must capture a first debit event followed by a later transaction failure and verify that the notifier records no committed debit.
suggested_fix: Define event outcome semantics at the notifier boundary: process BucketDebited and freeze-transition events only from finalized transactions with meta.err == null, while classifying CapRejected as a failed-attempt diagnostic. Include signature/slot/instruction-index idempotence. Add multi-mint and later-top-level-failure fixtures that retain logs but must not count a committed debit, plus a successful control counted exactly once.
rationale: adopted: WRD-EVT-01 pins notifier-boundary semantics — BucketDebited/freeze counted only from finalized meta.err==null tx; a rolled-back debit's surviving log is not a spend
